//: Per-machine settings. Copy to local.json (gitignored) and edit; anything left out uses the default.

stats.//kubeconfig: Kubeconfig for the Stats widget's Kubernetes section. Default: $KUBECONFIG, else ~/.kube/config.
stats.//context: Context to show. Default (""): the current context if its API server is on this machine (127.0.0.1 / localhost), else the first such context. Contexts pointing elsewhere are only used when named here.
